title: Semantically filtered authentic Mixamo motions for photorealistic 2.5D fighter research

source.note: Metadata candidates identified by names/prompts; not proof of visual quality or legal right to rehost source. Raw FBX kept out of public Git.

selection.criteria: Screened filenames AND original source descriptions across all 2,317 indexed Mixamo clips, excluding guns, swords, sporting props, irrelevant scene actions and unsuitable locomotion. 471 plausible research candidates; visual review, rigging and license review still pending.
selection.lastAcquisitionOutcome: HTTP 200 on retry followed by HTTP 429 Too Many Requests during bulk. Reattempt after server cooldown, with request pacing.
